description: The GlobalCroplandWUE research team publishes small Python routines for calculating and plotting cropland water-use-efficiency results. The calculation function reads net-primary-productivity and evapotranspiration rasters, masks selected invalid values and writes their ratio as a compressed floating-point GeoTIFF. A second script plots annual anomalies from spreadsheet summaries. Public source is free under MIT. Coverage follows the associated global cropland product, with functions adaptable to aligned local rasters for agricultural simulations and comparisons with model-invest. A caveat is that these are postprocessing fragments, not the complete EF-LUE and ETMonitor estimation system. Users must supply compatible units, aligned rasters and paths; the main entry point has an undefined parameter variable, and a declared scale factor is unused. Those details require adaptation before execution. No code was run.
